volatility_level_vs_momentum.reason: Fast moves occur below VIX20 on93 sessions, while VIX>=25 persists without fast momentum on248. Removing both momentum horizons removes12 contractual STRESS sessions and changes34 additional non-overlapping outcomes. These are distinct level/change semantics within one volatility family, not a new vote.

correlation_level_vs_deterioration.reason: Removing correlation deterioration changes32/1930 decisions; removing correlation level changes142, with no overlap in changed decisions. High correlation appears without high delta240 times and high delta below high correlation125 times. Deterioration is structurally distinct but has little direct adjudication effect; no evidence supports removal or a new independent family.

classification_policy: STRONG/MODERATE require identifiable non-redundant structure and consistent semantic role. WEAK denotes little direct adjudication contribution. No categorical claim of economic utility follows from disagreement. INDETERMINATE when independent utility cannot be measured.
